# Energy Contractor Insurance

> Energy Contractor Insurance (by Contractors Choice Agency) provides commercial insurance for this trade in all 50 states. Coverage lines: General Liability Insurance for energy contractors, Workers' Compensation for energy contractors, Commercial Auto & Fleet for energy contractors, Tools & Equipment Coverage for energy contractors, Errors & Omissions for energy contractors, Shop & Commercial Property for energy contractors, Umbrella / Excess Liability for energy contractors, Pollution & Environmental Liability for energy contractors. A-rated carriers. Licensed in all 50 states — NPN #8608479. Founded 2005. Contact: 844-967-5247, josh@contractorschoiceagency.com.
